```{r filter-params}
# age filter settings
min_age <- 5
max_age <- 13
min_age_gap <- 1/6
```

```{r load-scores}
# set of runs that are used for IRT model fitting
runs_filtered_trials <- read_rds(here("01_fetched_data/runs_filtered_trials.rds")) |>
  mutate(site_label = dataset |> fct_recode(!!!site_labels))

# score from all IRT models
mod_scores <- read_rds(here("02_scoring_outputs/scores/registry_scores.rds"))

# BIC / rxx from all IRT models
mod_stats <- read_rds(here("02_scoring_outputs/mod_stats.rds"))

# filter runs by min/max age
runs_aged <- runs_filtered_trials |>
  mutate(ex_age_missing = is.na(age),
         ex_age_interval = !is.na(age) & (age < min_age | age > max_age))

# filter runs by min age gap
included_runs <- runs_aged |>
  # filter(!is.na(age), age >= min_age, age < max_age)
  filter(!ex_age_missing, !ex_age_interval) |>
  arrange(user_id, task_id, time_started) |>
  mutate(age_gap_prelim = age - lag(age), .by = c(user_id, task_id)) |>
  filter(is.na(age_gap_prelim) | age_gap_prelim >= min_age_gap) |>
  mutate(run_number = 1:n(),
         age_gap = age - lag(age),
         .by = c(user_id, task_id)) |>
  select(site_label, task_id, user_id, run_id, language, adaptive, num_attempted,
         age, run_number, age_gap, time_started, time_finished)

# scores from all models, for only included runs
included_mod_scores <- mod_scores |> inner_join(included_runs, by = "run_id") |>
  filter(model_set %in% c("by_language", "multigroup_dataset")) |>
  filter_out(subset == "overlap_items") |>
  rename(score = ability, score_se = se) |>
  arrange(task, model_set, subset, itemtype, invariance, site_label, user_id, age) |>
  rename(item_task = task) |>
  left_join(task_info)

# scores for SRE (not IRT based)
sre_scores <- read_rds(here("02_scoring_outputs/scores/scores_custom.rds")) |>
  filter(item_task == "sre") |>
  select(item_task, run_id, score = metric_value) |>
  inner_join(included_runs, by = "run_id") |>
  left_join(task_info)

# scores using specified model for each task + SRE
task_scores <- included_mod_scores |>
  semi_join(task_mods) |>
  bind_rows(sre_scores)

# scores for core tasks only
coretask_scores <- task_scores |> filter(item_task %in% core_tasks)

# scores for core tasks only + first run for each user x task
coretask_firstrun_scores <- coretask_scores |> filter(run_number == 1)

# mapping between task_id and item_task
task_id_map <- task_scores |> distinct(task_id, item_task)
```
